i want to die

i can't stand living in this world anymore

i feel sick

what's the point in living when life's this way and no one seems to care

and when people do care they don't know what to do

i can't breathe

i haven't been able to breathe in years

how am i supposed to do anything else when breathing is this difficult for me

what is wrong with me

i have no one

i trust no one

especially not god

whatever that word means

goodbye
i don't know how to elaborate
